sections.Profile:
Aerobatics, produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in February 1977, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with an aviation theme. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, three drop targets, three standup targets, two kick-out holes, and two spinning targets.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Aviation, Single Player, Original Theme, 1970s, Single level playfield
